title: Bar Yeshita
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman describes him in Jerusalem Talmud Megillah, chapter 4, end of halakhah 10, as Rabbi Abbahu’s amora (spokesman) and the son of Rabbi Chinena. For teachings he had heard from his father, he would say, “Thus said Rabbi in the name of Father”; for teachings he had not heard from his father (and Rabbi Abbahu said them in his father’s name), he would say, “Thus said Rabbi in the name of Rabbi Chinena.” See also the entry Elazar bar Yeshita.

notes.text: Hyman names Abbahu. The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:10 paragraph names Rabbi Acha as Bar Yashita’s master and retains the two reporting formulas. The supplied Abbahu wording is preserved; this edition difference does not establish that the names identify the same person.
